tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Read-only. Returns public company, contact, service and URL information for POPSMEDIA.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Read-only. Returns complete public details for an exact POPSMEDIA service id, slug or name.

service.description: Exact service id, Romanian slug, English slug, Romanian name or English name.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Read-only. Lists public POPSMEDIA frequently asked questions and answers in Romanian and English, optionally filtered by text query or language.

query.description: Optional text query matched against FAQ questions and answers.

lang.description: Optional language filter for a simplified localized response.

tools.name: list_portfolio_projects
tools.description: Read-only. Lists public POPSMEDIA portfolio projects using the site's published portfolio data.

category.description: Optional category slug or category name.

query.description: Optional text query matched against titles, descriptions and categories.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of projects to return.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Read-only. Lists the public services offered by POPSMEDIA, optionally filtered by a text query.

query.description: Optional text query matched against service names, descriptions, features and deliverables.

tools.name: start_inquiry
tools.description: Action. Prefills the existing POPSMEDIA contact form for user review. It does not submit the form and performs no financial transaction.

service.description: Optional requested service id, slug or name.
